[RFCS.18.8] DS hand-parses these formats and does **not** inherit protobuf's
unknown-field handling. A reader **must** walk each `Atom`'s tags and **reject**
the stream (`DS_ERR_FS_UNKNOWN_INJECT`) if any unknown field number falls in the
inject band (`1–127`). The DSC container's analogue is the reject-band
(`128–255`) reject, mapping to `DS_ERR_DSC_VERSION` ([NERR.13]).

**This is a parse-safety rule.** An unknown inject-band field is an input the
writer asserted and this reader cannot represent; skipping it loses a fact the
stream carried, silently. The obligation is on what the reader can decode, not
on any version either side declares.
